title: Paprika Chicken Thighs in Sweet Corn Gravy
description: Chicken thighs braise in a sweet paprika broth that becomes a velvety corn gravy.
equipment: Immersion blender, heatproof jug and fine sieve

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken thighs
ingredients.note: Trim fat, unfold and halve crosswise.

ingredients.name: low-sodium chicken broth
ingredients.note: Choose plain meat-and-bone broth without a vegetable blend.

steps.title: Start the corn broth
steps.text: Bring {broth}, {paprika}, {garlic} and {corn} to a gentle simmer in the cast iron over medium heat.

steps.title: Braise the thighs
steps.text: Nestle {thighs} into the liquid, spoon broth over the tops and cover. Lower the heat and simmer 12–20 minutes, turning halfway, until the thick centers reach 175°F and pierce easily.

steps.title: Hold the chicken
steps.text: Move the thighs to a covered bowl with a spoonful of cooking liquid.

steps.title: Smooth the corn
steps.text: Blend the kernels and hot cooking liquid in a deep heatproof jug. Press through a fine sieve to remove hulls and return the smooth gravy base to the skillet.

steps.title: Mix the slurry
steps.text: Stir {starch} into {water} in a small cup until smooth.

steps.title: Thicken the sauce
steps.text: Whisk the freshly stirred slurry into the simmering sauce and stir for 1 minute, until it coats the back of a spoon.

steps.title: Finish the gravy
steps.text: Whisk {cheese} and {zest} into the gravy off heat until smooth.

steps.title: Coat and serve
steps.text: Cut the thighs across the grain into short slices and fold them through the corn gravy.

notes: Make ahead: Trim and portion the thighs and thaw the corn in the refrigerator a day ahead. Option A uses lime zest. For gentler Option B, omit the zest and use less paprika. For dairy-free gravy leave out the cream cheese. Refrigerate promptly in shallow portions and use within 3 days. Freezer-Friendly Verdict: Yes. Freeze the thighs surrounded by corn gravy for up to 2 months; add the cream cheese after reheating for the smoothest texture. Fridge reheat: Transfer a single portion with its sauce to a shallow covered oven-safe dish. Install the APO Gen 1 bottom drip pan. Preheat to 325°F, sous vide mode off, 60% steam, rear element on, top and bottom off. Set the probe to 165°F at the coldest center. Start checking at 12 minutes and heat to 165°F throughout. Freezer reheat: Thaw overnight in the refrigerator. Use the fridge reheating directions and stir the sauce smooth.
